links.outcome: Composite accuracy and safety scores of AI tools versus pharmacists on real-world drug information questions
links.effect: GPT-4o 18.3 and Medical Chat 17.5 comparable to pharmacists 17.7; Gemini 16.7 and Copilot 16.4 lower; Welch ANOVA p<0.001.
links.quote: GPT-4o and Medical Chat achieved composite scores comparable to DIC pharmacists (mean [standard deviation (SD)]: 18.3 [2.5], 17.5 [3.1], and 17.7 [3.5], respectively), while Gemini and Copilot showed lower performance (16.7 [3.5] and 16.4 [2.9]).

links.outcome: AI tool responses compared against drug information pharmacists on same questions
links.effect: GPT-4o and Medical Chat comparable to pharmacists; Gemini and Copilot lower; GPT-4o outperformed Gemini and Copilot in pairwise comparisons.
links.quote: Welch's analysis of variance (ANOVA) demonstrated a significant difference in composite scores among groups (p < 0.001), with GPT-4o outperforming Gemini and Copilot in pairwise comparisons.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the performance and accuracy of several LLMs (GPT-4o, Gemini, Copilot, Medical Chat) against drug information pharmacists on retrospective hospital drug information queries, without comparing specific deployment practices or safeguards.
